```{r}
#| message: false
features <- tibble(features = raw$features)
features <- unnest_wider(features, features)
features <- unnest_wider(features, properties)
features <- unnest_wider(features, geometry, names_sep = "_")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| message: false
fires <- features |>
  select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, agency, state, geometry_coordinates) |>
  mutate(
    gis_acres = as.numeric(gis_acres),
    fire_year = as.integer(fire_year)
  )
```

```{r}
#| message: false
august_fires <- fires |>
  filter(str_detect(incident, "August"))
nrow(august_fires)

fires |>
  arrange(desc(gis_acres)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)

ggplot(fires, aes(x = gis_acres)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  scale_x_log10()

fires_per_year <- fires |>
  group_by(fire_year) |>
  summarise(total_acres = sum(gis_acres, na.rm = TRUE))

ggplot(fires_per_year, aes(x = fire_year, y = total_acres)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Total Acres Burned by Wildfires per Year",
    x = "Fire year",
    y = "Total acres burned",
    caption = "Source: wildfire records in data/wildfires.geojson"
  )

fires_by_state <- fires |>
  group_by(state) |>
  summarise(total_acres = sum(gis_acres, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  arrange(desc(total_acres)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)
fires_by_state
```

```{r}
#| message: false
big_fires <- fires |>
  filter(gis_acres >= 100000) |>
  mutate(
    lon = map_dbl(geometry_coordinates, ~ mean(.x[[1]][, , 1], na.rm = TRUE)),
    lat = map_dbl(geometry_coordinates, ~ mean(.x[[1]][, , 2], na.rm = TRUE))
  )
```

```{r}
#| message: false
big_fires_by_agency <- big_fires |>
  count(agency, name = "number_of_fires")

ggplot(big_fires_by_agency, aes(x = agency, y = number_of_fires)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Big Fires by Managing Agency",
    x = "Managing agency",
    y = "Number of fires"
  )
```

```{r}
#| message: false
top_ten_fires <- big_fires |>
  arrange(desc(gis_acres)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  mutate(
    geometry = map(
      geometry_coordinates,
      ~ sf::st_polygon(list(drop(.x[[1]])))
    )
  ) |>
  sf::st_as_sf() |>
  sf::st_set_crs(4326) |>
  sf::st_make_valid()

top_ten_bounds <- sf::st_bbox(top_ten_fires)

leaflet(top_ten_fires) |>
  addTiles() |>
  fitBounds(
    lng1 = top_ten_bounds["xmin"],
    lat1 = top_ten_bounds["ymin"],
    lng2 = top_ten_bounds["xmax"],
    lat2 = top_ten_bounds["ymax"]
  ) |>
  addPolygons(
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<strong>", incident, "</strong><br>",
      "Year: ", fire_year, "<br>",
      "Acres: ", format(gis_acres, big.mark = ",")
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| message: false
rank_changes <- imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(snap_year %in% c(2015, 2022)) |>
  select(title, year, snap_year, rank) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = snap_year, values_from = rank, names_prefix = "rank_") |>
  filter(!is.na(rank_2015), !is.na(rank_2022)) |>
  mutate(
    rank_change = rank_2022 - rank_2015,
    release_decade = floor(year / 10) * 10
  )

print(rank_changes |> arrange(desc(rank_change)) |> slice_head(n = 10))

average_rank_change_by_decade <- rank_changes |>
  group_by(release_decade) |>
  summarise(average_rank_change = mean(rank_change), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(release_decade)

print(average_rank_change_by_decade)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| message: false
snapshot_years <- c(2015, 2017, 2019, 2021, 2022)
snapshot_urls <- c(
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20150101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20170101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20190101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20210101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20220201012049/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/"
)

scrape_imdb_snapshot <- function(address, snapshot_year) {
  page <- request(address) |>
    req_timeout(120) |>
    req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
    req_perform() |>
    resp_body_html()

  table <- page |>
    html_element("table") |>
    html_table()

  rank_title <- str_match(
    str_squish(table[["Rank & Title"]]),
    "^(\\d+)\\s+(.+)\\s+\\((\\d{4})\\)$"
  )
  rating_elements <- page |> html_elements("strong[title]")
  vote_counts <- str_match(
    html_attr(rating_elements, "title"),
    "based on ([0-9,]+) (?:votes|user ratings)"
  )[, 2] |>
    parse_number()

  result <- tibble(
    snap_year = snapshot_year,
    rank = as.integer(rank_title[, 2]),
    title = rank_title[, 3],
    year = as.integer(rank_title[, 4]),
    rating = table[["IMDb Rating"]],
    number = vote_counts
  )

  stopifnot(nrow(result) == 250)
  result
}

imdb_snapshots <- map2(snapshot_urls, snapshot_years, scrape_imdb_snapshot) |>
  list_rbind()
```

```{r}
#| message: false
ggplot(
  average_rank_change_by_decade,
  aes(
    x = average_rank_change,
    y = factor(release_decade),
    fill = case_when(
      average_rank_change > 0 ~ "Rank rose",
      average_rank_change < 0 ~ "Rank fell",
      TRUE ~ "No average change"
    )
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Direction",
    values = c(
      "Rank rose" = "#C75C5C",
      "Rank fell" = "#2A9D8F",
      "No average change" = "#8A8A8A"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Which Release Decades Changed Rank Most?",
    subtitle = "Average change in IMDb Top 250 rank from 2015 to 2022",
    x = "Average rank change (2022 - 2015)",
    y = "Release decade",
    caption = "Sample: 190 films appearing in both the 2015 and 2022 snapshots."
  )
```
